accept_criteria: Thesis and topics are grounded in transcript evidence, not generic podcast themes
Key claims have stable ids, claim_type, and transcript support
Memory patches (interview_identity, style, narrative, themes) are consistent with volley and prior speaker roles
Full timeline represented or shard/collate merge preserved non-tail claims
reject_patterns: Thesis contradicts transcript tail or major stated interviewee goals
Invented claims or topics with no transcript support
Truncation blind spots on decompose-eligible run without shard coverage
Generic filler themes (leadership, innovation) without evidence

deterministic_lint_notes.topic_evidence_anchors: topics need segment_ids or approx_time_range on long interviews
deterministic_lint_notes.key_claim_evidence_anchors: key_claims need segment_ids, evidence_segment_ids, or approx_time_range
deterministic_lint_notes.generic_theme_blocked: frozen generic theme names without evidence anchors fail lint
